caption_L1: This is a line plot called Median household income in Pennsylvania from 1990 to 2019 (in current U.S. dollars). The y-axis plots Household income in current U.S. dollars while the x-axis plots Year.
caption_L2L3: Household income has had a steady increase over time. Between 2000-2005 the income stayed the same and plateued. There was another dip around 2010 but then income shot up until now. Between 1995-2000 it did rise but with not a lot of growth.
